name: PolyAI (Agent Studio)
target_customers: Enterprises: 'dialog agents that handle your most critical enterprise conversations' in hotels, retail, banking, healthcare, telecom, utilities

entry_price.notes: Page shows '2¢' per connected minute, billed per second (token prices in $: $2/1M input, $5/1M output). Telephony and orchestration NOT included; 10 concurrent calls. This is the model API; the Agentic Dialog Platform (Agent Studio) is custom-quoted per minute by sales.

per_minute_from.notes: 2¢/connected minute for Dialog-RSN-1 API model only + text tokens; voice output free until 19 Nov; telephony/orchestration excluded. Platform per-minute rate not published.

hindi_hinglish.evidence: Languages page lists Hindi; no mention of Hinglish or code-mixed speech (multilingual docs describe switching between languages)

indic_languages.evidence: Languages page lists Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu alongside Hindi

outbound_inbound.evidence: Inbound voice agents plus documented Outbound Calling API / Agents API to trigger outbound calls

live_transfer.evidence: Docs: mid-call handoff to human via SIP REFER/INVITE with context passed in SIP headers or Handoff API

mid_call_actions.evidence: Tools/functions call APIs mid-conversation; built-in actions incl. send SMS, tool call, handoff; demo changes a booking

no_code_builder.evidence: Agent Studio: 'No-code to full code, without changing platform'

api_webhooks.evidence: Public Platform/Agents API, Outbound API, Conversations API and a Webhooks API with signed endpoints

built_in_crm.evidence: No native lead/contact pipeline documented; integrates with Zendesk, ServiceNow, Salesforce-type systems

whatsapp_followup.evidence: Homepage lists WhatsApp among channels; WhatsApp follow-up tied to voice calls not documented (SMS is)

post_call_analysis.evidence: Per-conversation transcripts, recordings, variables, function calls and quality scores; auto summaries/dispositions not documented

call_qa.evidence: PolyScore automated quality score on each conversation plus custom AI Scores (1-5) graded after every call

human_call_intelligence.evidence: No feature for analysing human-rep calls documented

telephony_included.evidence: Numbers can be bought from PolyAI in UK, US, Canada, Australia, Ireland; India not listed (BYO SIP/Twilio otherwise)

languages_claimed: 'Multilingual Dialog Agents in 75+ Languages' (page title); list of 42 incl. Hindi, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu

scale.customers_claimed: 100+ enterprises, 2,000+ live deployments in 45 languages and 25+ countries (Series D release, Dec 2025); site: 100M+ calls a year
scale.last_round: Series D $86M, Dec 2025 (total reported as 'over $200M'; CB Insights $204.5M)

notable_2025_2026: Raised $86M Series D (Dec 2025) co-led by Georgian, Hedosophia and Khosla; launched self-serve Dialog-RSN-1 API at 2¢/min in 2026

name: Aircall (AI Voice Agent)

per_minute_from.notes: 10,000+ min at 'custom rates starting from $0.19/min'; PAYG $0.49/min ($0.39/min above 2,500 min per FAQ). Inclusions of LLM/TTS not itemised.
